text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown emerged victorious from the 
fierce battle. It was a race where 
everyone gave their absolute all. And so, 
after the race—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black collapsed from accumulated 
fatigue, while Duramente was found to have 
injured her left leg.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To the anxious pair, Satono Crown speaks. 
Prepare thoroughly, train, and get in peak 
condition. By doing so, they will reach 
even greater heights.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Duramente and her team promise to 
recuperate in order to face Satono Crown 
once again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown also wished for a rematch 
with Cheval Grand. Hearing those words, 
Cheval Grand felt determined to decide 
upon her own path.
